spans.s: Gaura, a mountain. § 575 (Bhūmip.): VI, 12, 445 (ºs tu madhyame dvīpe girir mānaḥśilo mahān).
Gauraśiras, a muni. § 266 (Śakrasabhāv.): II, 7, 292 (muniḥ, in the palace of Indra).--§ 640 (Rājadh.): XII, 58, 2094 (muniḥ, among the authors--pranetāraḥ--of rājaśāstras).
Gaurāśva, an ancient king. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 329 (so B., C. has Goº; in the palace of Yama).
Gauramukha, a disciple of Śamīka. § 51 (Parikshit): I, 42, 1738, 1740, (1741), 1751, 1752. § 56 (do.): I, 50, 1975.
Gaurapṛshṭha, an ancient king. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 332 (in the palace of Yama).
Gauravāhana, a king. § 287 (Rājasūyikap.): II, 34, 1271 (pārthivaḥ, came to the rājasūya of Yudhishṭhira).
Gaurī^1 = Umā: III, 8129 (śikharaṃ vai Mahādevya Gºyāḥ); IV, †2305 (mūrtimatīva Gºī).
Gaurī^2, a goddess in the retinue of Umā. § 506 (Skandayuddha): III, 231, 14562 (followed Pārvatī, i.e. Umā).

Gaurī^3, the wife of Varuṇa. § 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 117, 3968 (reme…Varuṇaś ca yathā Gºyāṃ).--§ 768b (UmāMaheśvarasaṃv.): XIII, 146, 6751 (Varuṇasya, sc. sādhvī). --§ 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7637 (Varunaḥ saha Gºyā).
Gaurī^5 = the Earth (so Nīl. and PCR.). § 768b (UmāMaheśvarasaṃv.): XIII, 146, 6756.
Gaurīśa (“the husband of Gaurī”) = Śiva: XIV, 210.
Gaurīhṛdayavallabha (“dear to Gaurī's heart”) = Śiva: X, 258.
